faq.q: How does Titanium Smartwatch Bezel affect wireless signal transmission?
faq.a: Grade 5 Ti-6Al-4V has electrical conductivity of approximately 0.6 × 10⁶ S/m, significantly lower than aluminum (37 × 10⁶ S/m) or copper. For premium smart watch, this means reduced eddy current losses in antenna near-field regions. However, antenna design must account for the conductive housing — typically with >2 mm clearance or FPC antenna placement on the outer surface.
